formula: Pearson/Spearman over positions: raw router projection score vs signed mean post-GELU fc1 activation
aggregation: Equal layer-expert or pair-count weighted; aggregation labeled per row
reference: Fixed source-final dense reference or each model native input
population: 2048 registered validation positions; all-expert counterfactual first 128 positions; max 128 layer-expert identities
verified_definition_checks: Score is not probability; GELU includes bias; signed not absolute; all-expert capacity N/A
limitations: Native model inputs and route populations differ; seed unit n=5.

formula: Centered linear CKA; unsquared relative Frobenius error; mean cosine; mean squared principal-angle cosine
reference: Same-step dense on identical fixed_source or dense_native hidden vectors
population: 2048 validation positions; 4x32 experts; post-GELU hidden and complete fc2 output
verified_definition_checks: Feature/sample ranks separate; 1e-10 relative eigenvalue numerical rank and N-1 limit; degeneracy flagged
limitations: Dense-native inputs move by checkpoint; fixed-source inputs fixed.

aggregation: Per-layer ratios and ratio of aggregated energies separately
reference: Same-step dense gates (moving ref) or fixed source-final gates
population: 2048 probe positions; capacity decision on full 16384-token validation batch
verified_definition_checks: Numerator and denominator are squared norms; dropped positions zero in full metric; accepted-only separate
limitations: Ratio may change from numerator and/or reference-output energy.

aggregation: Batch mean, equal layer per seed; 10 exact-count random draws for task
population: 16 train batches indices 0,20,...,300; 4 layers x 32 experts x fc1/fc2
verified_definition_checks: fp32 TF32-off; mean token CE; dense denominator complete; zero gradients undefined
limitations: Training data seen during training; only task has random controls; n=10 null draws.

formula: Uncentered Gram overlap using XaXaT, XbXbT, XaXbT; rank 1/2/4/8
reference: Masked dense task gradient and sparse task gradient
population: 16 batch vectors with aligned fc1/fc2 weight coordinates
verified_definition_checks: Direct-SVD unit test; rank cutoff 1e-10 relative eigenvalue; no parameter covariance formed
limitations: No random subspace baseline or cutoff-degeneracy diagnostic saved.

formula: Keep/prune over expert fc1/fc2 weight coordinates
aggregation: Tensor, expert joint, layer/matrix, layer, condition
verified_definition_checks: Keep budget is jointly allocated within each expert over fc1+fc2; biases unmasked
limitations: Per-matrix keep rates differ from nominal target.

formula: C is direct mask-selection state; D is isolated C with next mask; delta CE and KL(C||D)
aggregation: Per seed; counts also per tensor/expert/layer
reference: C checkpoint and next IMP mask
population: Same validation probe; whole-model native routing for CE/KL
verified_definition_checks: Router/shared parameters unchanged; whole-model route assignment not frozen

formula: Sparse validation CE <= matched same-seed dense CE at 5000 attempted steps
aggregation: Strict binary per condition; seed unit
verified_definition_checks: No tolerance; same precision within each rerun pair; historical/rerun duplicate weights not independent
